title: Pruvz Public Evidence Packet — ordered evidence timeline
description: The action's complete append-only evidence timeline as the Pruvz product API reports it (GET /api/actions/{actionId}/evidence): every item in sequence order, each exposing its business-readable fields only. The trust level is server-assigned — derived from the evidence type, never a caller input — and this schema enforces that derivation structurally.

actionId.description: The action this timeline belongs to. Must equal action.actionId in the same packet (a cross-object rule JSON Schema cannot express; see the documentation).

evidenceItem.description: One timeline entry: what happened, where it came from, how much independent trust it carries, and when.

sequence.description: Position on the action's timeline; allocation is atomic and starts at 1.

type.description: The kind of event on the timeline. Each type maps to exactly one trust level (enforced below).

trustLevel.description: How much independent trust the item carries. Always server-derived from the type: CLAIMED (agent-asserted), EXECUTION_RECEIPT (relayed receipt), INDEPENDENT_READBACK (observed by Pruvz directly from the system of record), PRUVZ_DERIVED (derived by Pruvz itself).

source.description: The system this evidence came from, e.g. an agent identifier, a source-system identifier, or a Pruvz component identifier.

sourceReference.description: An identifier inside the source, e.g. a refund or ticket id; null when none applies.

occurredAtUtc.description: When the event occurred or was observed. Agent-asserted for claims.

recordedAtUtc.description: Server time the evidence was recorded by Pruvz.

summary.description: Business-readable one-line summary of the item.

utcTimestamp.description: A UTC timestamp: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with the Z (Zulu) UTC designator, matching the *AtUtc field names. Local-offset forms such as +03:00 are not valid in this contract.
